## Pull Request Guidelines

### Description
Provide a clear description of the modifications, resolving issues, or architectural improvements introduced.

### Link to Issue
Resolves #

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change resolving crashes)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change introducing business logic)
- [ ] Code style update (Ruff formatting / variable names)
- [ ] Documentation update

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the PEP8 / ESLint project coding standards.
- [ ] I have written accompanying unit/integration tests verifying my logic.
- [ ] Tests pass locally on my workspace environment.
- [ ] Documentation is updated in `/docs` and READMEs.
